services.name: Good Sam Member RV Site Discount
services.desc: If combining incredible coastal views with the comforts of home sounds like the ideal vacation to you, then this is your ideal RV site. Full hookups-including 30/50 AMP, water, sewage, cable, ethernet and Wi-Fi-help keep your family and your appliances running smoothly. Enjoy your space and parking pad with decomposed granite that will make parking a breeze. And an outstanding outdoor space,-complete with ocean views, a picnic table and a natural gas fire pit-adds a whole lot of ambiance to every meal. With stunning scenery and simple creature comforts, this RV site offers a suburb Central Coast stay. This site has a 21-day maximum

services.name: Walk-In/Bike-In Camp Site
services.desc: The Central Coast offers some unbelievably beautiful biking. And this dry site with ocean views offers you the chance to make the most of it. With a personal propane fire pit, it delivers a little extra ambiance. The site is outfitted with a fire ring so your personal propane fire will be protected from the wind. And with communal picnic tables, it gives you the chance to share meals, stories and tips with other cyclists while you’re here. You’ll also enjoy amazing communal amenities and the clean bathhouses you’ll have access to while you’re here. If you’re more interested in connecting with nature than you are in having access to a car, then this site is perfect for you. A 7-day maximum

services.name: Surfside Sauna Discount for Guests
services.desc: Flying Flags Avila guests can receive 20% off with Surfside Sauna by stopping by the Welcome Center or Lookout Room. With seating up to 8, and parked right below Flying Flags, enjoy a luxurious sauna experience Thursday-Sunday. Your session includes use of the sauna, wellness area, and access to the Pacific.
